what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Russia in Italy: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 770 Russian asylum seekers in Italy, 0.9% of all asylum seekers from Russia.
Refugees from Russia, a separate group, live mostly in France, Germany, the United States and Austria.

why.text: UCDP records an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025, at war level in each of those years.
It also records armed conflict over the government of Russia in 2023 and 2024, with LSR, RDK and Wagner as opponents.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2010 at 13 asylum seekers.
The figure is at its highest at the end of 2025, and the main years of displacement in the data are 2022 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Italy.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Italy only.
